name: RADICAL DREAMERS -Nusumenai Houseki-
source:
Radical Dreamers is a text-based adventure game taking place after the SNES RPG Chrono Trigger. It aims to tie up a loose end from Chrono Trigger, and features two recurring characters from that game. The story follows the thieves Serge, Kid, and Magil as they sneak into a large and foreboding mansion to find the Frozen Flame.

[From [url=http://www.chronocompendium.com/Term/Radical_Dreamers_FAQ.html]chronocompendium.com[/url]]

Was later remade into the 1999 role-playing game [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chrono_Cross]Chrono Cross[/url].
translation:
《RADICAL DREAMERS》是一款文字冒险游戏，故事发生在超级任天堂角色扮演游戏《时空之轮》之后。它旨在补完《时空之轮》遗留的一条线索，并让该作的两名角色再度登场。故事讲述盗贼塞尔吉、基德与魔吉尔潜入一座庞大而阴森的宅邸，寻找“冰冻之炎”。

[摘自[url=http://www.chronocompendium.com/Term/Radical_Dreamers_FAQ.html]Chrono Compendium[/url]]

本作后来被重新改编为1999年的角色扮演游戏[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chrono_Cross]《穿越时空》[/url]。
